import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x7f7f7f7f;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Arc {
        int destination;
        int remaining;
        int weight;
        int next;
        
        Arc(int dest, int rem, int w, int nxt) {
            destination = dest;
            remaining = rem;
            weight = w;
            next = nxt;
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<Arc> network;
    static ArrayList<Integer> first;

    static void link(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        network.add(new Arc(v, cap, cost, first.get(u)));
        first.set(u, network.size() - 1);
        network.add(new Arc(u, 0, -cost, first.get(v)));
        first.set(v, network.size() - 1);
    }

    static int readInt() {
        int val = 0;
        int ch;
        try {
            ch = System.in.read();
            while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
                if (ch == '-') break;
                ch = System.in.read();
            }
            boolean negative = false;
            if (ch == '-') {
                negative = true;
                ch = System.in.read();
            }
            while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
                val = val * 10 + (ch - '0');
                ch = System.in.read();
            }
            if (negative) val = -val;
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
        return val;
    }

    static void printInt(int val) {
        if (val < 0) {
            System.out.print('-');
            val = -val;
        }
        if (val > 9) printInt(val / 10);
        System.out.print((char)(val % 10 + '0'));
    }

    static void println(int val) {
        printInt(val);
        System.out.println();
    }

    static int source, sink;
    static ArrayList<Integer> dist, flow, prevNode, prevArc;
    static ArrayList<Boolean> inQ;

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(dist.toArray(), INF);
        Arrays.fill(flow.toArray(), 0);
        Arrays.fill(prevNode.toArray(), -1);
        Arrays.fill(prevArc.toArray(), -1);
        Arrays.fill(inQ.toArray(), false);
        
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dist.set(source, 0);
        flow.set(source, INF);
        q.add(source);
        inQ.set(source, true);
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inQ.set(u, false);
            
            for (int idx = first.get(u); idx != -1; idx = network.get(idx).next) {
                int v = network.get(idx).destination;
                int cap = network.get(idx).remaining;
                int cost = network.get(idx).weight;
                
                if (cap > 0 && dist.get(v) > dist.get(u) + cost) {
                    dist.set(v, dist.get(u) + cost);
                    flow.set(v, Math.min(flow.get(u), cap));
                    prevNode.set(v, u);
                    prevArc.set(v, idx);
                    if (!inQ.get(v)) {
                        q.add(v);
                        inQ.set(v, true);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        return prevNode.get(sink) != -1;
    }

    static int totalFlow, minCost;

    static void minCostFlow() {
        while (spfa()) {
            int augment = flow.get(sink);
            totalFlow += augment;
            minCost += augment * dist.get(sink);
            
            int cur = sink;
            while (cur != source) {
                int arcIdx = prevArc.get(cur);
                Arc forwardArc = network.get(arcIdx);
                Arc backwardArc = network.get(arcIdx ^ 1);
                
                forwardArc.remaining -= augment;
                backwardArc.remaining += augment;
                
                cur = prevNode.get(cur);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int n = readInt();
        int m = readInt();
        int k = readInt();
        int c = readInt();
        int d = readInt();
        
        int B = Math.max(n, k);
        source = n * (2 * B + 1) + 1;
        sink = source + 1;
        
        dist = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(sink + 1, INF));
        flow = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(sink + 1, 0));
        prevNode = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(sink + 1, -1));
        prevArc = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(sink + 1, -1));
        inQ = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(sink + 1, false));
        first = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(sink + 1, -1));
        
        network = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = readInt();
            link(source, x, 1, 0);
        }
        
        link(n * (2 * B) + 1, sink, INF, 0);
        
        for (int layer = 0; layer < 2 * B; layer++) {
            link(layer * n + 1, (layer + 1) * n + 1, INF, 0);
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                link(layer * n + i, (layer + 1) * n + i, INF, c);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = readInt();
            int y = readInt();
            for (int layer = 0; layer < 2 * B; layer++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) {
                    int cost = d * (2 * j - 1) + c;
                    link(layer * n + x, (layer + 1) * n + y, 1, cost);
                    link(layer * n + y, (layer + 1) * n + x, 1, cost);
                }
            }
        }
        
        minCostFlow();
        println(minCost);
    }
}
